suggested_experiment_name: BBN (4He abundance) constraint on axion DM-induced EDM
coupling_convention: g_d in GeV^-2 (axion-gluon CP-violating EDM coupling), emitted exactly as plotted on the y-axis
notes: Cosmological BBN bound on axion DM coupling to G-Gtilde, expressed via the oscillating-EDM coupling g_d (GeV^-2) vs axion mass m_a. Boundary derived from the paper's analytic constraint f_a*m_a > 1.3e-9 GeV^2 (for m_a>1e-16 eV, using g_d = 2.4e-16 e*cm / f_a = 1.22e-2 GeV^-1 / f_a), giving excluded g_d > 9.4e-3 * m_a[eV] GeV^-2. Below 1e-16 eV the bound softens (~m_a^{1/4}); lowest point uses that branch. This is the CASPEr-type axion-EDM coupling, closest enum is AxionEDM but values are the coupling g_d in GeV^-2, NOT the neutron EDM d_n in e*cm. Not a haloscope (cosmological mean density used), so no local DM density. CASPEr curves in Fig.1 right panel are projections, not the paper's result. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.5, 26)) | Vision: Left panel of Fig.1.
